name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 40 – Am 63
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 40c. Calls for an amendment to the Statute for Members of the European Parliament and the relevant implementing rules, in order to abolish the transitional allowance for former Members and replace it with access to national unemployment benefits under the same conditions as other workers;
